map.药物诱导血小板减少 (DITP) 风险评分器 使用指南: Drug-induced Thrombocytopenia (DITP) Risk Scorer User Guide
map.基于 George 因果判定标准，输入所用药物、血小板下降时间、恢复情况及骨髓与: Based on the George causality criteria, enter the drug used, the timing of the platelet drop, recovery, and bone marrow and antibody evidence, scoring item by item to judge whether the thrombocytopenia is drug-induced (DITP), helping distinguish drug-induced from immune thrombocytopenia.
map.按 George 因果标准四项（时间/恢复/排除/再激发）逐项判分: Score item by item against the four George causality criteria (timing / recovery / exclusion / rechallenge)
map.肝素类重点用 4Ts 评分单独评估 HIT: For heparin, use the 4Ts score separately to assess HIT
map.：George 因果判定（改良）：时间关系、停药后恢复、排除其他原因、药物再激发: : George causality criteria (modified): temporal relationship, recovery after withdrawal, exclusion of other causes and drug rechallenge, 4 items scored 0-2 each for a maximum of 8. At least 8 is definite, 5-7 very likely, 3-4 possible, below 3 unlikely. A high score means the drug should be stopped permanently and the allergy recorded.
map.：例（时间明确符合 +2、停药后 PLT 恢复 +2、已排除其他病因 +2、既往: : example (clear temporal fit +2, platelet recovery after withdrawal +2, other causes excluded +2, previous positive rechallenge +2): total = 8 -> 'Definite'; the drug should be stopped permanently. If only timing and recovery score 1 each with the rest 0 -> 2 points -> unlikely, so focus on immune ITP and other causes.
map.肝素用什么评分？: What score is used for heparin?
map.肝素诱导血小板减少（HIT）有独立的 4Ts 评分（血小板减少幅度、 Timin: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) has its own 4Ts score (magnitude of platelet fall, timing, thrombosis, other causes) and does not use this DITP tool; HIT still carries thrombosis risk after stopping the drug and needs a switch to a non-heparin anticoagulant (argatroban / bivalirudin).
map.再激发阳性为何权重最高？: Why does positive rechallenge carry the highest weight?
map.再用药后 PLT 再次下降是药物因果的最强证据（特异度高）；但临床上极少主动再激: A platelet count falling again after re-administration is the strongest evidence of drug causality (high specificity); but deliberate rechallenge is rarely done clinically and is usually confirmed from history, so judgement relies mostly on the first three items combined.
